# axiz-core-commons

Request/page/header metadata, JSON, concurrency and transaction contracts.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-commons</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AsyncLoadingCache` | Bounded TTL/use-count cache and pending native loads, with coalescing, eviction fencing and last-caller cancellation. |
| `BoundedCallbackExecutor` | Startup-created callback workers with lock-free bounded admission, immediate rejection and no caller-runs fallback. |
| `Stages` | Native stage composition, cancellation and scoped callback context through a JDK-only SPI. |
| `ApiResponse` | Optional response envelope for services whose consumers require one. |
| `Environments` | Operational profile of a deployment (`axiz.config.environment`). |
| `Generated` | Marks a class written by a generator, not by a person (the models openapi-generator produces from the contract of a service); JaCoCo leaves such classes out of the coverage gates. |
| `HeaderCatalog` | Catalog of business headers a service accepts, validates and propagates. |
| `HeaderDefinition` | Declares a business header in the header catalog. |
| `Page` | A page of results. |
| `PageMetadata` | Pagination metadata returned with a page. |
| `PageRequest` | Page request with zero-based page index. |
| `PageResponse` | Standard paginated response body. |
| `RequestContext` | Metadata of the request or message being processed by the current thread. |
| `RequestMetadata` | Immutable metadata of the request or message being processed. |
| `Sort` | Sort specification parsed from `field,asc;other,desc` or repeated `field,dir`. |
| `StandardHeaders` | Names of standard headers used across HTTP and messaging. |
| `JsonReader` | Minimal, strict JSON parser (RFC 8259) producing `Map<String, Object>`, `List`, `String`, `BigDecimal`, `Boolean` and `null`. |
| `JsonWriter` | Minimal JSON writer for maps, collections, strings, numbers, booleans, enums, dates and UUIDs. |
| `TransactionRunner` | Runs work inside a transaction (Spring: `TransactionTemplate`). |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-commons verify`.

## JDBC extraction in 2.0

The JDBC implementation and SQL resources now live in `axiz-kit-jdbc`; this module contains
framework-neutral contracts and orchestration. `TransactionRunner` remains in
`pe.axiz.core.commons.tx`. Use the capability catalog/`axiz upgrade` to add JDBC adapters with
`runtime` scope in a service. See [JDBC migration](../../arquitectura/jdbc.md).

## Language helpers in 2.0

`Checks`, `Strings`, `Dates` and `Result` live in
[`axiz-core-lang`](axiz-core-lang.md), package `pe.axiz.core.lang`. A domain that only
needs these helpers should depend directly on that JDK-only module. This module retains
`LeaseTiming` (the shared monotonic lease deadline), `SqlIdentifiers` (textual identifier validation)
